sections.label: Education levelling-up support programmes
sections.summary: Education is a leveller; school-based levelling-up programmes, financial support, Student Care Centres and special educational needs support will be strengthened.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: Beyond imbuing values and imparting knowledge and skills, education is a critical leveller of societal gaps, so that no child gets left behind.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: We will continue to strengthen our school-based levelling-up programmes to support academically weaker students and provide financial support for students from financially challenged families to cope with the costs of education.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: We will also expand Student Care Centres to provide an after-school environment conducive to learning for more students from a less advantaged background.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: We will step up efforts to support children with special educational needs through school-based programmes, specialised services, special education schools and programmes in collaboration with employers to smoothen transition from school to work.

sections.label: Industry attachments and university places
sections.summary: Industry attachments and the SkillsFuture Earn and Learn Programme will be emphasised, and publicly-funded university cohort participation will rise from 32% to 40% by 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: Accordingly, we will place greater emphasis on industry attachments, as well as other learning formats, such as the SkillsFuture Earn and Learn Programme – a modern apprenticeship programme.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: We will increase cohort participation rates for publicly-funded University places from 32% today to 40% by 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: NUS has the NUS Overseas Colleges to nurture entrepreneurs; Yale-NUS' Liberal Arts Programmes cater to students with broad thirst for knowledge; NTU and SUTD are developing new generations of engineers through their Renaissance Engineering and innovation and design-centric programmes respectively; SMU offers many double major programmes and is strengthening its emphasis on inter-disciplinary learning; and SIT and UniSIM will launch more applied degree programmes, with a strong nexus with industry, to develop talent with specialised skills and an ability to innovate.

sections.label: Lifelong learning and SkillsFuture Credit
sections.summary: Lifelong learning will be overseen by MOE, with more part-time programmes, modular courses, ECG, learning portfolios and SkillsFuture Credit.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: Whatever highest qualification a student leaves the education system with, we want him or her to continue the journey of education through his or her lifetime – learn the latest technology and thinking, practise his or her trade to perfection, plug into and acquire auxiliary know-how.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: We will increase the number of part-time programmes and skills-based modular courses at the post-Secondary education institutions to facilitate this lifelong learning process.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: The enhanced ECG, individual learning portfolios and enablers, such as the SkillsFuture Credit, will better empower individuals to take charge of their own skills improvement journey.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: To make the learning experience seamless, lifelong learning will be overseen by MOE.
